(JNMC), as the leader, joined up other related enterprises in Gansu to improve Secondary Battery Industry Union construction program, so far the program has passed by Gansu Committee and government, which showed Gansu New Energy and New Material Industry Union was officially formed and the government accepted the achievement in battery field made by JNMC. In 2012, Chinese government released many new energy industry planning and promoted secondary battery and key battery material to a strategic height, which brought new developed opportunity for Gansu and JNMC. New Energy and New Material Industry Union takes lithium-ion secondary battery, nickel-hydrogen secondary battery, vehicle power battery, and storage battery and key secondary battery material such as Ni-Co-Mn ternary system, Ni-Co binary system, lithium-ion fer

rous phosphate, hydrogen storage alloy, battery and lithium carbonate as key developed direction. The union will integrate competitive enterprises and assort other related enterprises to form industrial cluster and attract foreign enterprises such as directly absorb new energy auto producer for improving the development of upstream material and battery industry. 

Gansu, as the important mineral resource and energy province in West China, owns rich solar energy, wind resource and nickel, cobalt developing secondary battery and battery material, in the meanwhile it forms a certain foundation in new energy industry, JNMC, Baiyin Group, Gansu Rare Earth, Baiyin Zhabuye Lithium Industry, Fangda Carbon and Gansu Daxiang all set feet in secondary battery material production and establish professional R&D team and test platform. Through untiring effort and research, Lanzhou Jinchuan Technology Park made achievement in lithium secondary battery, Ni-Co-Mn ternary system, lithium-ion ferrous phosphate and lithium carbonate, of which, lithium ion battery and anode material precursor and nickel-hydrogen battery ranks top in China and owns competitive advantage. 

During the industry union, JNMC will join up other enterprises to utilize and develop lithium ion battery and anode material precursor, lithium ion battery anode and cathode material, wind energy and solar energy. Meanwhile it will inject foreign advanced method to improve and add this industry. Gansu has great advantage in labor, material, capital, and talent flow and land utilization and the government will draw up specific support program and finally form a whole industrial chain “Mineral Resource-Battery Material-Secondary Battery (Vehicle Power Battery and Storage Battery)-New Energy Auto, New Energy Development-Battery Recycle and Utilization”, which will add a powerful driving force for the economy take-off and technological development. 

In addition, the State Council of China issued No. 104 document which agreed to establish Lanzhou New Area. According to this document, establishing Lanzhou New Area is important for exploring north-west old industrial cities transformation development, carrying on industries revolution in east, middle areas of China, enhancing Lanzhou’s driving effect, expanding western opening-up and promoting balance development between different regions. With this, Lanzhou New Area became the fifth state-level new area after Shanghai Pudong New Area, Tianjin Binhai New Area, Chongqing Liangjiang New Area and Zhejiang Zhoushan Islands New

# **<u>Antimony Market Overview for H1</u>** 

##### **Market review in August** 

The domestic antimony market extended stagnant operation in August, until late August, the market transaction slightly rebounded. The major features of market: sufficient supply, weak

demand and steady price. The main stream transacted prices of antimony ingot (99.65%) and antimony oxide (99.5%) were stabilized in the range of 68,500-70,000yuan/t and 59,000-61,000yuan/t, respectively. In the middle of the month, although suppliers raised quotations for antimony ingot (99.65%) and antimony oxide (99.5%) to 71,000-72,000yuan/t and 61,000-62,000yuan/t, the transacted price wasn’t changed due to weak demand in down-stream market. Due to cost, antimony ingot suppliers refused to cut price, and down-stream customers were also holding watching attitude, so antimony ingot price is in dilemma. Seen from the antimony products export, the major quotation of antimony ingot (99.65%) was maintained at US$12,200-12,500/t, and the main stream export FOB price of antimony oxide was stabilized at FOB US$9,700-9,900/t. The overseas customers didn’t return to market due to summer holidays, so export market demand dropped and there was a few enquires, but order forms were rare; overseas customers reflected that there was small volume of transactions below the price. In accordance with prices collected by Antaike, the quotation of antimony ingot (99.65%) was stabilized at 68,500-71,000yuan/t in August. In the middle of the month, the quotation grew in small scale by about 2,000yuan/t, but it didn’t have effect on transacted price. The average quotation of antimony ingot (99.65%) was 68,500-70,000yuan/t in August, up by 0.1% m-o-m and down by 24% y-o-y. **-** **Table 1 Antimony monthly average price in Jan. Therefore, despite some large size domestic antimony products producers remained in normal production, the total supply of domestic antimony products trended down. Seen from the supply of antimony ore raw material, on one hand, some mines suspended mining due to low profit or environment survey, so antimony ore suppliers would not like to reduce price; on the other hand, affected by partial smelters, antimony ingot producers had no motiv

ation to purchase products temporarily. Therefore, transactions of antimony ore were not active; buyers and sellers were watching. Market features are strong price and slow transactions. The stagnant situation is difficult to be broke before market resume. Seen form the down-stream demand, domestic antimony consumption industry’s low operation rate didn’t get improved, but transactions in antimony oxide market saw small scale growth, which will have positive impact on antimony market. Affected by European and American economy, the global demand of antimony oxide plummeted, which directly had negative impact on the whole demand for antimony products. Market participants commonly believe that with returning of overseas customers in September, the market may get stimulated and resumed. Antaike believes under the current situation, the resume scale of demand will be limited, while market confidence may get raised. Seen from supply and demand level, antimony market will probably stay in stagnant situation. ##### **Policies** In order to protect and utilize mineral resource rationally, MLR issues the total mining quota for tungsten, antimony and rare earth mines in 2012. The total mining quota for antimony ore (metal content) will be 10,5000t, including 75,360 main mining quota and 29,640t integrated utilization quota. MLR also stresses to continue to suspend the treat of application for new tungsten, Website: www.antaike.com 4 Minor Metals Monthly No.150 antimony and rare earth mine exploration, mining registration and other related requirement. It will be implemented in accordance with [2011]227 file issued by MLR. ##### **Statistics** ##### **Output** In accordance with statistics released by CNIA, China produced 19.3kt antimony products in July, down by 16.32% m-o-m. The total output in Jan.-Jul. was 118.8kt, up by 3.57% y-o-y. The output of antimony concentrate in July was 11.3kt (metal content), up by 15.56% m-o-m, and the total output of antimony concentrate in the first seven months was 57.7kt (metal content), down by 1.21% y-o-y. The statistics above has double count problem, please take it just as a reference. ##### **Import & Export** 

Import: in accordance with statistics released by China Customs, China imported 6,807t antimony products in July and 38,983t in Jan.-Jul., up by 5.28% y-o-y. Among which, the import of antimony concentrate was 6,622t in Jul., up by 29.54% m-o-m. The total import of antimony concentrate in Jan.-Jul. was 37,367t, up by 4.87% y-o-y. The first five countries China imported antimony concentrate in the first seven months are Russia, Tajikistan, Thailand, Burma and Australia. 

Export: China exported 3,528t antimony products in July and 25,399t in Jan.-Jul., up by 0.5% y-o-y. Among which, the export of antimony oxide in July was 2,488t, down by 28.22% m-o-m. They are mainly exported to USA, Taiwan, Hongkong and Japan, respectively were 612t, 505t, 421t and 374t, accounting for 76.8% in the total export of antimony oxide. The total export of

The export of unwrought antimony in July was 1,035t, down by 50.6% m-o-m, mainly exported to UAS, Japan, Netherlands and South Korea.  The total export of unwrought antimony in Jan.-Jul. was 5,597t, up by 64.52% y-o-y. 

##### **Outlook** 

In line with the above analysis, the antimony market remains in slow operation now. The cost support price is hard to drop, while weak demand restricted price from growth, so the price is in dilemma. The market remained being lack of enough motivation. The market remained in stagnant and need patience to not the small change of market. The antimony ore price is strong, and supply is steady, which are significant factors for supporting antimony ingot price to be strong. 

Currently, global market demand is weak. Most of customers buy products in line with demand and hold watching attitude for the future market. The domestic antimony down-stream industry remains in low operation and needs a period to resume. However, the resuming signal seems appear recently. On the other hand, market participants commonly look forward to see overseas customers to return to market and buy products in September, which undoubtedly has positive impact on market confidence. The demand improvement extent is not expected to be large, either. At present, the domestic antimony stock level is high, and most of producers suffered serious deficit since price dropping in Q2 2011 and they would not like to sell products by cutting more price. Seen from the price tendency in August, it was strong and strongly against dropping trend. From which, it is estimated the antimony market saw more possibility to stop dropp

ing and become steady, even break the stagnant situation. 

Generally, Antaike products that the domestic antimony price in September would be steady. If the market demand was resumed as expected, the price will see a rebound process. However, the hope of that is small. It is forecasted that the average price of antimony ingot (99.65%) in September will be more than 70,000yuan/t, and the average price of domestic antimony ingot (99.65%) may in the range of 69,000-71,000yuan/t in the whole Q4,and the international market standard II antimony average price will be above US$ 12,000/t. 

# **<u>Cobalt Market Overview</u>** 

### **Domestic Market** 

##### **Market review** 

Although domestic cobalt smelters have reduced production, the market supply was still full in general; due to weak terminal demand, Chinese cobalt price always maintained low in early Aug., with the coming of traditional consumption season of battery field in Sept., market inquiry increased, but the transaction was not improved greatly; Chinese cobalt price followed global market and slightly increased. The average Chinese cobalt price was 219,100yuan/t in Aug., down by 1.62% m-o-m. 

As you can see from comparison chart of Changjiang spot market and MB quotation, due to high cost support, Chinese cobalt price was higher than that on global market in the first half of Aug; global cobalt price increased significantly in the second half of Aug., Chinese cobalt price increased steadily.

#### **Supply** 

##### **Chinese cobalt raw material import decreases by 26.1%** 

According to the statistics from the Customs, from Jan. to Jul., 2012, the accumulated cobalt ores & conc. reached 111,966t, equivalent to 6,718t of metal content, down by 48.09% y-o-y; import of intermediate products of cobalt wet-processing metallurgy was 42,229t, equivalent to 6,757t of metal content, up by 16.52% y-o-y; import of alliage blanc was about 5,194t, equivalent to 1,039t of metal content, up by 16.22% y-o-y. In conclusion, import in the first seven months of 2012 was about 14,514t, down by 26.1% compared with 19,635t in 2011. 

In respect of imported raw material, as domestic smelters basically stayed in a loss state, considering the reduction of cost, they adhered

to import cobalt wet-processing metallurgy and alliage blanc, thus import increased. The main reason for the decreasing import was that cobalt price stayed at a low level in 2012, domestic smelters proved less willing to import raw material and they began to consume inventory or adhered to purchase domestic cobalt salt as production raw material; besides, partial domestic smelters stopped or reduced production, which also lowered the demand for cobalt material. 

#### **Consumption** 

##### **Export of lithium cobalt oxide increases by 79.1%** 

According to the latest statistic from the Customs, export of lithium cobalt oxide was 605t in Jul. 2012 and the accumulated export in Jan.-Jul., 2012 reached 4,102t, up by 84% y-o-y, export of lithium cobalt oxide is expected to reach 7,000t in 2012. That in 2011 was 4,524t.

From this table, as the largest cobalt consumption field in the world (30% share), cobalt consumption demand in battery field still kept a strong growth in 2012. **Output of lithium-ion battery increases by 34.6%** 

From Jan. to Jun., Chinese lithium-ion output reached 1.784 units, up by 34.64% y-o-y. Of which, output in Jun. was 392mln units, up by 50.06% y-o-y, touch monthly record high. Two traditional demand of lithium-ion battery are laptop and mobile phone. In H1 2012, output of mobile phone was 527mln units, up by 5.17% y-o-y; output of laptop was111mln units, up by 4.3% y-o-y. 

The main motivation of the growth of lithium-ion battery output was from the change of downstream product demand structure. 

According to some statistics, Chinese smart phone output in H1 2011 was 100mln units while that in H1 2012 increased to 160mln units, up by 60% y-o-y. Of which, Huawei produced about 55mln units of mobile phone, including 20mln smart phones; Huawei plans to produce more than 100mln units of mobile phone in 2012, including 60mln smart phones. Traditional mobile phone only needs 1Ah lithium-ion battery capacity, smart phone needs 2Ah, thus smart phone lifts the demand of lithium-ion battery. 

Following the example of IPAD, Lenovo, Huawei, Hisense, Hasee, Newsmy and other local manufacturers joined the scrum to occupy tablet computer market. According to some statistics, Chinese tablet computer demand reached 20mln units in H1 2012, up by 100% y-o-y. A unit of 7 inches tablet computer needs two 4Ah lithium-ion batteries, which means table

t computer promoting more than 5% growth of lithium-ion battery. 

In terms of downstream demand in Jan.-Jun., 2012, Chinese lithium-ion battery consumption still depended on mobile phone battery, consumer electronic products battery and laptop battery. Demand accounted for 80% of lithium-ion battery total demand; Demand for new energy auto only accounted for 2%, electric car, power tool and miner light & toy accounted for 2%, 3% and 13%, respectively. 

##### **Wanxiang Group buys A123** 

On Aug. 10, 2012, American Battery Maker A123 Systems Inc. (A123 Inc.) expressed Wanxiang Group planned to invest US$465mln buying 80% shares of A123 Systems Inc. 

A123 Inc. is advanced developer and producer of lithium battery and storage system for traffic and transportation and power grid. A123 Inc.’s Nanophosphate(R) lithium-ion ferrous phosphate battery patented technology mainly uses nano material from Massachusetts Institute of Technology, which can provide stronger battery power and energy density and increase safety factor and extend battery life. A123 Inc. uses breakthrough advanced technology, manufacturing process and professional integrated system to provide innovative solution for customers. 

A123 Inc. is a star enterprise under the background of green energy development advocated 

Website: www.antaike.com 

9

by Mr. Obama, US Department of Energy has injected US$250mln capital in this enterprise and even its market value reached US$2.6bln in the past several years. However, American auto mobile industry developed slowly affected by Financial Crisis, the capital of A123 Inc. also gradually dried up and was not able to operate for several months. 

According to sources from CEO of A123 Inc., Wanxiang Group actively looked for them four months ago, after discussion for several months and the two sides got an MOU. According to the content of this MOU, Wanxiang Group will provide US$75mln initial debt finance for A123 Inc. and it will buy US$200mln senior secured convertible bonds from A123 Inc. under certain conditions in later stage. In addition, this MOU includes Wanxiang Group’s US$175mln options and warrants. So far the letter of intent is non-binding, A123 Inc. and Wanxiang Group are negotiating the final contract and they hope to finish it before late 2012. 

A123 Inc. chooses different development way comparing with Japanese and South Korean enterprises. A123 Inc. pays more attention to develop lithium-ion ferrous phosphate market while Japanese and South Korean focus on ternary and lithium manganese market. Although lithium-ion ferrous phosphate gets a late start, it develops fastest in large-scale lithium battery field. 

#### **Import and export Import data** 

Import of refined cobalt reached 1,339t in the first seven months of 2012, down by 27.1% y-o-y; import of cobalt salt reached 447t in Jul., up by 95.2% y-o-y; the accumulated import of cobalt salt was 1,786t,

down by 13.55% y-o-y. The decreasing import was mainly due to domestic oversupply cobalt market, while the continuous weak terminal consumption led to the slow import demand of foreign products. 

##### **Export data** 

Export of refined cobalt reached 1,984t in the first seven months of 2012, up by 6.44% y-o-y; export of cobalt salt was 322t, down by 8.78% y-o-y; the accumulated export of cobalt salt reached 2,860t, up by 24.67% y-o-y. Of which, export of cobalt tetroxide was 2,046t, up by 40.81% y-o-y; export of cobalt carbonate was 329t, down by 39% y-o-y; export of cobalt oxalate was 308t, up by 211% y-o-y; export of cobalt dioxide and cobalt hydroxide was 151t, up by 3.4% y-o-y. As a whole, the accumulated export of refined cobalt, cobalt powder and cobalt salt reached 5,166t in the first seven months of 2012, up by 14.52% y-o-y. The increasing export was mainly due to surplus domestic market in 2012, the cobalt demand increased slowly, leading global cobalt price was higher than domestic cobalt price in most time and export enterprises were willing to export products. 

#### **Outlook** 

After the summer break ends, terminal consumers will return to the market and purchase and restock; Sept. is the traditional consumption season in the field of battery which will support cobalt price; but due to global cobalt market stays in an oversupply state, the increasing rate will be limited. Chinese cobalt market will follow the trend of global market. 

# **<u>Indium Market Overview</u>** 

T he refined indium price increased by about RMB 50/kg to RMB 3,600-3,650/kg in early 

Website: www.antaike.com 

10 

Minor Metals Monthly                                        No.150 

August on the domestic investment. Then, the price declined to RMB 3,450-3,550/kg in late of the month. At the end of August, there was sources said the govt. would purchase indium for stockpiles that stimulated the price. At the beginning of September, the refined indium price increased to RMB 3,500-3,600/kg, while the crude indium price climbed to RMB 3,200-3,300/kg. The FOB of refined indium was US$ 500-530/kg at the beginning of August, which touched a low of US$ 470-500/kg and closed at US$ 480-500/kg at the end of the month. 



There were two situations influenced the indium market in August. One was the increase of indium import that affected the domestic market confidence. The statistics released by China Customs show that China imported accumulative 4.8 t of indium in Jan.-Jul., and there was estimate that the total refined indium import reached 10s t in the first 7 months. The raised import was caused by the higher domestic price against the foreign ones. Traders disclose there is hundreds RMB of profit in importing 100kg of refined indium through legal way. Another situation was the information for building stockpiles. Accordingly, the market become reluctant to sell and wait for the rise of price. Then, the indium price stopped decline and began to rebound at the

end of August. Now, the inquiry becomes more, while the quotation of RMB 3,200/kg of crude indium is rare. The holders of indium product are waiting for the possible further growth on potential advantages like the QE3 from FED. Generally, the market anticipates a new range of growth of indium price. The domestic refined indium price would be at RMB 3,500-3,750/kg. However, the domestic stock is in a relative high level. The export price would not increase too fast. Recently, indium use in alloys sector increased, which is mainly used in anticorrosion in ocean environment. China uses about 2-3 t of indium in the sector. The product is mostly exported to Middle East and used in domestic downstream industry. The latest data from China Customs show that China exported 5 kg of refined indium in July, down by 99.93% y-o-y. In the first 7 months, the total indium export was 3,486 kg, down by 95.44% y-o-y. Meanwhile, China imported 2,276 kg of unwrought indium and 189 kg of wrought indium, which totaled 2,465 kg, up by 524.05% y-o-y. In the first 7 months, the accumulative indium import was 4,803 kg, up by 70.62% y-o-y.
